subject: CodeQL alert text for #67 and #75 (the cloud has no code-scanning API)
body: Please mail the full text of the two open code-scanning alerts, which only your gh can read: `gh api repos/DanFashauer/SignalGrid-Review-Hub/code-scanning/alerts/67` and `.../alerts/75` (rule.id, rule.description, message.text, most_recent_instance.location with start_line, state, created_at). #67 is high js/user-controlled-bypass on artifacts/api-server/src/middlewares/context.ts:125, open since 2026-07-19, the same day 470713df rewrote that middleware fail-closed; the cloud needs the alert's current instance location to decide fix versus dismiss-with-reason. #75 is medium js/http-to-file-access on scripts/prune-merged-branches.mjs:370. With the text in hand the cloud does the engineering; nothing here needs the owner.
